subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella while the open cadence-guardrail and guarded retention PRs are reviewed, or should maintainers split and close/narrow the remaining slices now?
rationale: The source-backed bug is real, but the complete requested direction spans compatibility-sensitive session cleanup plus an operator-facing cron cadence policy that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Keep umbrella until linked slices settle
options.body: Track the combined user problem here while reviewing the retention and cadence PRs, then split only verified leftovers after those decisions land.

options.title: Split remaining work now
options.body: Make retention, cadence, context-warning, and sessions-cleanup separate canonical issues before closing or narrowing this umbrella.

options.title: Reject core cadence policy
options.body: Keep the retention bug path open but explicitly close or narrow the cadence-guardrail slice if core should not own that policy.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella until linked slices settle
recommendation.body: Track the combined user problem here while reviewing the retention and cadence PRs, then split only verified leftovers after those decisions land.
